article.hook: You nod through another meeting while your mind counts the weight on your shoulders. Lilith in Capricorn shows up like that: a long stretch where the hardest thing is admitting the load isn’t lighter because you’re pretending it is.
article.lived: For about nine months, you hold yourself like a fortress - quiet, composed, and unmoving - while the world expects you to deliver without pause. The phone doesn’t ring with offers of help; you don’t ask. You manage budgets, deadlines, and feelings like separate accounts, making sure no one sees the cracks forming inside. Everyone notices your control, but no one sees the small betrayals of your own limits.
article.turn: Endurance becomes a trap when the act of managing alone becomes the refusal to share the load. The cold shell that keeps you in command also blocks relief. Expecting failure before it arrives makes every offer of help feel like a test you must fail alone. The truth is that carrying everything yourself isn’t strength - it’s a slow fracture that no one else will fix.
